main_text.l: Plura his ex Hippocrate, Galen. aliys huc transcripta nolui: quòd quæ desyderari possunt, partim à me inter docendum, partim à diligenti lectore suffici facilè queant, ne quis primam manum hanc & rudem, parumque digestam farraginem accusét, in auditorum tantùm gratiam foras prodeuntem: vt habeant exercitationis medicæ rudimentum quoddam, non opus absolutum, sed audiendo, absoluendum.

page.notes: The running head and page number are printed in the top margin; the signature mark is at the foot right. The word "FINIS." is set as a closing word, so it is written as a paragraph, not a heading. Possible doubtful readings: "aliys" and "absoluendum" may be printing variants; "accusét" is printed with an accent over the e.
